objective.text: After `agentos checkpoint --task <id> --next "<action>"`, the next agent's startup path (`agentos status`, `agentos context <engine> --task <id>`, `agentos resume --task <id>`) presents exactly one current next action: the most recently saved one. Older or contradicting next-action text in handoff.md or tasks.md is shown as superseded, never as current. Nothing is silently deleted.

acceptance.text:
- After `agentos checkpoint --task <id> --next "<action>"`, `agentos status`, `agentos context <engine> --task <id>` and `agentos resume --task <id>` present exactly one current next action: the most recently saved one.
- Older or contradicting next-action text in handoff.md or tasks.md is not presented as current; the next agent can tell it is superseded.
- Nothing is silently deleted.
